sub_questions.question: Is there a monthly cap on API calls on the free plan?

claims.claim: Sandbox (free) workspaces are capped at 5,000 API calls per month.
claims.guide_evidence: | Sandbox | Free | 200 credits, one-time (does not renew) | 1 | 5 | 50 | 50 MB | 5,000 calls/month |

claims.claim: Upgrading to Professional does not change the API call cap.
claims.guide_evidence: | Professional | $59/workspace/month ($590/year) | 5,000 credits/month | 3 | 50 | 500 | 5 GB | No Dify-imposed API rate limit |

claims.claim: Only the Team plan removes the Dify-imposed API limit.
claims.guide_evidence: Professional ... No Dify-imposed API rate limit

customer_safety_issues: States an incorrect plan entitlement that could lead the customer to buy the more expensive Team plan unnecessarily.
evaluation.rationale: The Sandbox 5,000 calls/month cap is correct, but the answer wrongly says Professional keeps that cap and that only Team removes it. The guide says Professional has no Dify-imposed API rate limit. This plan-entitlement error could push the customer to overpay for Team.
